svg.title: Named a Rock
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 6 panels. Panel 1 (John 1:40-42): Andrew leads his brother Simon to Jesus, who stands with His arms open. Caption: "Andrew brings his brother Simon to Jesus. Before Simon has said a word, Jesus renames him Cephas, “Rock”." Jesus says: "You are Simon the son of John. You shall be called Cephas." Panel 2 (Matthew 16:13-16): Jesus, arms open, asks the question; Peter answers, hand on his heart. Caption: "At Caesarea Philippi Jesus asks, “But who do you say that I am?”" Peter says: "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God." Panel 3 (Matthew 16:21-23): Peter takes Jesus aside and rebukes Him; Jesus turns on him. Caption: "Then Jesus speaks of His cross." Peter says: "Far be it from you, Lord!" Jesus says: "Get behind me, Satan!" Panel 4 (Matthew 26:69-74; John 18:18): in the high priest's courtyard a servant girl points at Peter across a charcoal fire; a rooster stands in the yard. Caption: "Night, by a charcoal fire. Three times." A servant girl says: "You also were with Jesus the Galilean." Peter says: "I do not know the man." Panel 5 (John 21:9-17): on the lake shore at dawn Jesus and Peter face each other across a charcoal fire, the boat drawn up behind. Caption: "Dawn, by a charcoal fire. Three times." Jesus says: "Simon, son of John, do you love me? … Feed my sheep." Peter says: "Yes, Lord; you know that I love you." Panel 6 (Acts 2:14, 38-41): Peter, two of the apostles behind him, preaches to a crowd in a city street. Caption: "At Pentecost Peter stands up with the eleven and preaches. About three thousand are added that day." Peter says: "Repent and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins." The point: Jesus named Peter a rock before he had earned it, prayed for him before he fell, and made his return his commission. When you fall and turn back, your return can strengthen others too: “when you have turned again, strengthen your brothers” (Luke 22:32).
